dates_revision: re-screened 2026-09-27; supersedes 2016-10-26/11-21/12-21/2017-01-17/02-20, which had the same channel-dominance fragility found for I1 (Referral was top-magnitude, correctly-signed conversion_rate mover on only 4/5 dates, and 2017-02-20 failed outright). See notes/PLAN.md 5.1.

pass_condition.description: Referral must be the channel-dimension segment with the largest |actual - expected| for conversion_rate, with actual < expected, and verdict in {strong, plausible} (q<0.10).

pass_condition_revision: revised 2026-09-27: (1) %-share thresholds replaced with magnitude-rank, same reason as I1. (2) verdict bar downgraded from strong (q<0.05) to plausible (q<0.10) -- the two-proportion test lacks power to reach q<0.05 for a -40% cut at Referral's ~15-20 txns/day. Measured, not assumed: across the 105-date non-colliding candidate pool, Referral reached strong on only 9/105 (8.6%) vs plausible-or-better on 19/105 (18.1%); on the final 5 dates, 2/5 strong, 5/5 plausible-or-better. Also confirmed by a cut-size sweep on one date (-40% -> q=0.14, -70% -> q=0.02, -90% -> q=0.001). This is a power limit of the injected magnitude, not a date-selection problem. See notes/PLAN.md 5.2.
